grammar.query: Exactly one explicit .proj/.props/.targets XML path and at least one colon-form -getProperty/--getProperty//getProperty token. Exact documented switch spelling. Query lists use semicolon or comma separators, nonempty ASCII property identifiers only. Repeat tokens and exact/case-varied names retained in request order.
grammar.globalOverrides: Colon-form --property/-property//property//p/-p/--p, one Name=Value assignment per token. ASCII names, last case-insensitive override wins; empty value supported. Raw comma/semicolon assignment lists explicitly outside admitted CLI profile; percent-escaped data follows existing evaluator limits.
grammar.bounds: At most256 tokens, total32768 UTF16 chars, max64 query names/64 global property tokens; same evaluator input/import bounds unchanged.

outputs.scalar: Exactly one requested name -> property value plus OS newline; absent value -> empty line
outputs.multiple: Two or more requested names -> indented Properties JSON, exact-spelling keys overwritten in original insertion position; case-varied keys distinct. Native basic-Latin JSON encoding including HTML-sensitive, backtick, nonASCII and control escapes, uppercase hex; selected Q07 raw bytes observed.
outputs.informational: Owned help/version/info format differs from native; real0.1.100-dev.1, actual canonical source-set fingerprint, declared base7f7, actual JDK vendor/runtime/arch; no invented source Gitcommit or Microsoft version identity.
outputs.warnings: Existing evaluator duplicate/cycle/condition codes and available origin paths on stderr; no claimed byte-identical native diagnostic prose or invented location/cycle chain. Scalar/JSON stdout remains clean.
outputs.errors: Unknown options and zero/multiple explicit-project syntax errors exit1 on stdout, matching observed command-error channel with owned diagnostic prose. Evaluation failures/capability refusals stderr nonzero; native MSB4019 only where same evaluator provides it. XML_PROFILE remains owned profile diagnostic, not falsely relabelled allDTD/entity refusals MSB4025.
outputs.refusal: Targets/noquery/build/restore/run/test/pack/publish/getItem/getTargetResult/resultfile/responsefiles/loggers/solutions/SDKstyle/prelude/Directory.Build selection explicitly unsupported; arbitrary unexecuted task declaration is OUTSIDE_ADMITTED_PROFILE, no task executed.

launch.jdk: Explicit JAVA_HOME full locked MicrosoftJDK21, source launcher memory compilation before driver identity checks; all product staging after release/java/javac/jar/libmodules/providers/source hashes validated. Startup follows same selected JDK contract.
launch.root: Own script/JAR root independent cwd, no symlink/reparse entry/root/JDK/source/output path alias support; DOTJ_ROOT absent or canonical matching only.
launch.selection: Conservative explicit unsupported global.json if encountered in cwd ancestors or explicit project parent ancestors to filesystem root. No SDK selection/parser.
launch.transport: Actual OS shell quoting preserves user arg array including empty argument, Unicode, spaces/metacharacters. Empty stray argument is syntax error rather than dropped. No product debug/test-only commands.

build.dependencies: Only locked JDK+source+declared OSshell; no preinstalleddotj/Git/Python/.NET/Maven/Gradle dependency
build.sourceClosure: Six inherited evaluator/module sources unchanged plus owned internal entry. Canonical LF Java; explicit ordered UTF8 release21 proc:none emptyclasspath/sourcepath.
build.publication: Fresh owned staging, deterministic JAR metadata, complete immutable versioned payloads and atomic current selection; previous usable payload retained on failure/controlled interruption. No source/sibling deletion.
build.identity: Product0.1.100-dev.1; actual SHA256 canonical source-set fingerprint and base7f7; no clock/absolute paths in artifact

qualification.inherited: All affected semantic harnesses against final new SDKJAR mandatory; source/class equality only additional provenance
